rationale: It describes query access over existing datasets and a SQL relational columnar engine with high-speed query and ingestion, conventional database functions. Change capture and accounting for connection differences are integration tasks, without a learned or model-based mechanism stated.
evidence_spans: Just point to your datasets and make them readily available for queries, analysis, and data exploration without loading them directly into HeavyDB.
DB is a SQL-based, relational, and columnar database engine specifically developed to harness the massive parallelism of modern GPU and CPU hardware.
It can query up to billions of rows in milliseconds and is capable of unprecedented ingestion speeds
